patterns.title: Cross-tenant global cryptographic primitive
patterns.root_cause: A generic route invokes a process-wide decryption key without binding ciphertext to owner, object, or purpose.

detection_signature.codeql: CallNode.getCalleeName() = decryptMessage under a route module

patterns.title: Protocol confidentiality without identity binding
patterns.root_cause: Encrypted Nostr envelopes are accepted without validating every signature, ID, author, recipient, kind, and application-trusted identity.

detection_signature.codeql: Calls to JSON.parse after nip44 decrypt without verifyEvent

patterns.title: Durable state claimed without crash-recovery lease
patterns.root_cause: A durable processing status removes work from future queries before irreversible effects complete, without a stale lease recovery path.

detection_signature.codeql: Database update to triggered or processing followed by provider/file effects

patterns.title: Non-atomic absolute counter update
patterns.root_cause: Concurrent requests read the same count and write the same absolute increment; errors authorize.

detection_signature.codeql: Select count then update count with local arithmetic

patterns.title: Safe HTTP method performs third-party side effect
patterns.root_cause: GET handlers create billable provider objects while Lax cookies allow top-level cross-site navigation.

detection_signature.codeql: Exported GET calling createCustomer, createCheckoutSession, or createInvoice

patterns.title: Entitlement not bound to canonical paid item
patterns.root_cause: Signed provider events are trusted for entitlement without validating an allowlisted product, amount, currency, and interval.

detection_signature.codeql: Webhook handler writes pro tier without reading validated provider price

patterns.title: Arbitrary subject security-state mutation
patterns.root_cause: An unauthenticated caller selects another user's email and invalid input mutates durable lockout state.

detection_signature.codeql: Remote email source flows to failedAttempts/lockedUntil update

patterns.title: Script-readable recovery material adjacent to raw HTML sink
patterns.root_cause: High-value shares and keys persist in Web Storage while the origin lacks CSP and ships a demonstrably vulnerable sanitizer at a raw HTML sink.

detection_signature.codeql: Web Storage write of share/key/privateKey plus raw HTML sink
